summary: The simulation runs syntactically and functionally with an agent-based mask adoption model, but it does not fully implement the specified metrics, validation criteria, or all policy feedback mechanisms from the task description. Parameter mappings also diverge in several places from the provided spec.

issues.description: Required metrics are missing or only partially implemented: time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption_rate, adoption_disparity_index, policy_effect_size, average_enforcement_events_per_day, masks_purchased_per_capita, campaign_reach (ever exposed), post_policy_dropoff_rate.
issues.location: Result assembly in SocialSimulation.run() and accumulated series in SocialSimulation.step()
issues.solution: Compute and include the missing metrics: (a) time_to_50_percent_adoption by finding the first day adoption_rate >= 0.5; (b) peak_adoption_rate as max(adoption_rate); (c) adoption_disparity_index by comparing adoption across groups (e.g., income terciles already stored in Person.group); (d) policy_effect_size via a counterfactual or difference-in-differences using pre/post windows; (e) average_enforcement_events_per_day as mean of (penalties_count + denied_access); (f) masks_purchased_per_capita as cumulative_masks_purchased / population_size; (g) campaign_reach as share ever exposed at least once (track a set of exposed agent IDs across the entire horizon); (h) post_policy_dropoff_rate by measuring slope or percent change after policy lift.

issues.description: Validation criteria from the spec are not computed or reported: adoption_convergence, stock_nonnegativity, bounded_probabilities.
issues.location: No explicit validation checks in the code output
issues.solution: Add a validation section to the output. Compute: (a) adoption_convergence by checking if daily adoption changes < 0.01 for last 7 days; (b) stock_nonnegativity by asserting retailer.mask_stock never < 0; (c) bounded_probabilities by verifying all computed p_wear and related probabilities are within [0,1] (or ensure mathematical constraints guarantee it). Report pass/fail status and any offending timesteps.

issues.description: Parameter mapping diverges from the spec: retailer_initial_stock_per_100_agents, penalty_for_noncompliance, mandate_enforcement_level, campaign_intensity are not mapped or used as specified.
issues.location: SocialSimulation._extract_parameters() and use sites in step()
issues.solution: Map spec parameters to internal names: (a) retailer_initial_stock_per_100_agents -> retailer_initial_inventory_per_capita = value/100; (b) penalty_for_noncompliance -> penalty_amount; (c) mandate_enforcement_level -> location_enforcement_mean or PolicyAuthority.enforcement_strength; (d) campaign_intensity -> messaging_intensity. Use these parameters wherever enforcement strength or campaign effects are applied.

issues.description: Policy feedback interaction is not implemented: mandates and campaign intensity do not adjust based on observed adoption or compliance.
issues.solution: Implement feedback logic to adjust PolicyAuthority.mandate_status and/or communication_strategy_intensity based on recent adoption/compliance trends (e.g., lift mandates after sustained high adoption or strengthen enforcement if compliance lags).

issues.description: Entity attributes differ from the spec (e.g., gender, socioeconomic_status, workplace_id, political_identity, perceived_norm).
issues.solution: Add missing fields (even if unused) for completeness and compatibility with the spec, or clearly map existing fields (e.g., income terciles as socioeconomic_status, location_type/workplace as workplace_id surrogate) and document the mapping.

issues.description: MediaOutlet and GovernmentHealthAuthority are represented by InformationChannel and PolicyAuthority, respectively, but their behaviors do not fully reflect 'amplify_or_counter_misinformation' and 'adjust_policies_based_on_outcomes'.
issues.solution: Expand InformationChannel to model amplification/countering of misinformation (e.g., adjust misinformation_rate dynamically), and implement outcome-based adjustments in PolicyAuthority.

issues.description: Average enforcement events per day are not explicitly tracked, though fines and denied access are recorded separately.
issues.solution: Track and report average_enforcement_events_per_day as the mean of (penalties_count + denied_access) across days.

issues.description: A few functions and parameters are unused (e.g., has_docker, DATA_DIR, SupplyChain not integrated with Retailer), and gini() is defined but unused.
issues.solution: Remove unused code or integrate SupplyChain with Retailer restocking and price dynamics. Consider computing Gini for adoption_disparity_index to use the existing function.
